page_title: AI Form Filler & Online PDF Form Filler

sources.entry: Instafill.ai - AI-powered PDF form filler. Auto-completes any PDF form by extracting fields and filling them from saved profiles, uploaded files, or supplied data. #paid

summary.name: Instafill.ai
summary.one_liner: Instafill.ai is a browser-based AI tool that reads uploaded PDF or Word forms, extracts their fields, and fills them using data you provide.
use_cases: Filling out government or visa application PDFs
Completing insurance claims and policy applications
Automating mortgage and lease paperwork for businesses
Converting scanned or flat PDFs into fillable forms
Batch-filling the same form from a CSV of records
Filling forms on behalf of another person using a profile
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a PDF or Word document, and the AI identifies each field, checkbox, table and radio button, then fills them from uploaded files, typed answers, or data from earlier fills. Flat, scanned and image documents can be converted into fillable PDFs before filling. The page says a typical PDF fills in 25–60 seconds and documents up to 100 pages are supported. Batch filling from a CSV file is supported, with results downloadable as an archive or individually. Saved answers let repeat fills need mainly review, and an API and webhooks are offered for automated runs.
notable: Converts flat PDFs, scans and images into fillable PDFs before filling
Stateless mode deletes files after processing; US default hosting on Microsoft Azure with optional regions
Offers a BAA for HIPAA-related customers, plus API and webhook access
Form Complexity Index: published 0–100 score for form difficulty
caveats: Free accounts can fill forms, but paid plans are needed for higher volumes, team workspaces and API access
For complex forms with no instructions, the page notes an increased risk of errors
A desktop app is optional, not required
